unclassified_narrative.quote: The OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report on the status of a subscription, redemption or a switch order.

Usage
The OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report on the status of a subscription, redemption
or a switch order.

unclassified_narrative.raw_quote: The OrderInstructionStatusReport message may be used to give the status of:

unclassified_narrative.quote: one order message by using OrderDetailsReport or,

unclassified_narrative.quote: one or more switch orders by using SwitchOrderDetailsReport.
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote: one or more switch orders by using SwitchOrderDetailsReport.

unclassified_narrative.quote: If the OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report the status of an individual order, then IndividualOrderDetailsReport is used and the order reference of the individual order is quoted in OrderReference.
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote:
If the OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report the status of an individual order, then
IndividualOrderDetailsReport is used and the order reference of the individual order is quoted in
OrderReference.

unclassified_narrative.quote: The message identification of the message in which the individual order was conveyed may also be quoted in RelatedReference but this is not recommended.

conveyed may also be quoted in RelatedReference but this is not recommended.

unclassified_narrative.quote: If the OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report the status of a switch order, then SwitchOrderDetailsReport is used and the order reference of the switch order is quoted in OrderReference.

If the OrderInstructionStatusReport message is used to report the status of an entire order message, for
